name: DOB Permit Issuance
description:
This dataset contains New York City Department of Buildings permit issuance records for construction, demolition, and other building work across the five boroughs. Each row represents a single permit tied to a specific job and property, with details on permit type and status, work type, filing and issuance dates, expiration, and job start dates. Location fields include borough, building and lot identifiers, community board, ZIP code, and latitude/longitude coordinates, along with neighborhood names and council districts. The data also records the people and businesses involved, including permittees, license types and numbers, owners, superintendents, and site safety managers, plus owner contact and business information.

The sample is skewed toward Manhattan, Brooklyn, and Queens, and most permits are issued rather than in process or re-issued. Many optional fields, such as special districts, oil/gas details, and site safety manager information, are largely missing, so analyses should account for that.
